page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; one block of verse lines in the centre; catchword-like signature "L 3" and "Pro" at the foot. Faint show-through of the reverse page in the margins, not transcribed.
page.notes: Running head is set in small capitals; page number 165 is printed at upper right. Catchword "Pro" and signature "L 3" are at the foot. Some letters are blurred by show-through, notably in "centremisco" and "Natū", which are copied as they appear. Left and right margins carry only show-through from the reverse side, which is omitted.
